notes.title: First Update
notes.content: [p][b]Our first update is here, and it’s packed with some cool new features and improvements for all drivers out there:[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]NEW FEATURES[/b][/p][p]🔹 2 new vehicles![/p][p]🔹 [b]Dynamic Rain:[/b] A new random rain option that requires you to adapt to changing weather during gameplay.[/p][p]🔹 [b]Edit Profile:[/b] You can now change your username.[/p][p]🔹 [b]Traffic:[/b] Option to disable traffic in Endless mode.[/p][p][/p][p][b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/p][p]🔹 [b]Brakes:[/b] We've improved the braking system to increase its effectiveness.[/p][p]🔹 [b]Rearview Mirror:[/b] Some interior rearview mirrors were malfunctioning and have been fixed.[/p][p]🔹 minor bug fixes[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332750/bcea8167b850e1705cfea2ebd58ec6bb5732cd45.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332750/89676cf71f2b46956cc1c56aef4e9732ea5a6d37.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Thanks for for supporting the game![/b][/p]
